lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three roughly vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The central column consists of three distinct spots forming a near-linear vertical arrangement, while flanking columns show two spots each, creating a semi-regular 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, forming grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features are visible across the flank. The most prominent ridge in the upper third shows a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with an attached remora is visible on the ventral-lateral region below the mid-flank ridges.
